defensiveAbilities.name: Sensitive Eyes
defensiveAbilities.description: The mutant desert drake's cluster of extra eyes are connected to a gland that, when punctured, causes the drake to rush into a fury. When a desert drake takes damage from a critical hit, it becomes Dazzled and Quickened for 1 round.

defensiveAbilities.name: Wing Deflection
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The desert drake is targeted with an attack.

Effect The desert drake raises its wing, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the desert drake is flying at the time it is attacked, it descends 10 feet after the attack is complete.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Frenzy
offensiveAbilities.description: The desert drake makes two Fangs Strikes and one Tail Strike in any order.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sandstorm Breath
offensiveAbilities.description: The desert drake spits a ball of electrically charged sand to a range of 60 feet that explodes into a cloud with a 15ft Burst. Creatures in the area take 9d6 Electricity Damage damage (Basic DC 28 Reflex Saving Throw save). The cloud remains for 1d4 rounds, granting Concealment to everything within. The desert drake can't use Sandstorm Breath again for 1d6 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Speed Surge
offensiveAbilities.description: The desert drake moves up to twice its Speed. It can do this three times per day.

offensiveAbilities.name: Surprise Attacker
offensiveAbilities.description: On the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted yet are Off-Guard to the desert drake.

offensiveAbilities.name: Push 5 feet
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Push in its damage entry

Effect The monster attempts to Shove the creature. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the monster's multiple attack penalty. If Push lists a distance, change the distance the creature is pushed on a success to that distance.
